verdict.rationale: Ente provides an official CLI (ente-cli) that can run headlessly to export/backup Auth codes, which is scriptable and could be used in automation/CI contexts, but evidence only documents it for exporting/decrypting backups, not for generic headless operation, generating TOTP codes on demand, or CI-integrated workflows. Missing for 10: documentation of CLI usage for retrieving/generating codes programmatically, CI-specific examples, and any first-party statement about automation/agentic use beyond backup.
